chain_words.nuance: running slowly and calmly for exercise
moving on foot at a normal fast pace
running quickly for a short distance
running as fast as possible for a short time
suddenly running away at great speed

explanation: These words all describe moving on foot, from slow, relaxed running to sudden, very fast escape.

usage_notes.difference: 'Jog' describes slow, relaxed running, often for exercise; 'run' is the general word for moving quickly on foot.
